Consent Form


Title: Understanding of AI decisions



Principle Investigator:

Associate Professor Brian Lim

Organisation: School of Computing, National University of Singapore

Email: brianlim@comp.nus.edu.sg



Before participating in this research, please read the following items.



Participation is voluntary.

You must be at least 21 years of age to participate. It is your choice whether or not to participate in this research. If you choose to participate, you may change your mind and leave the study at any time. Refusing to participate or choosing to stop your participation will not result in any penalties.



What is the purpose of this research?

This study aims to investigate how people understand and change AI decisions, and whether general problem-solving approaches are related to how people perform this task.


What is the approximate number of research participants involved?
300.



What will be done if I take part in this research?

You will complete a tutorial and screening test, followed by training and testing tasks involving AI decisions. After the main task, you will answer questions about how you approached it, four short general problem-solving questions, and demographic questions.



What are the risks and possible discomforts?

None.



Are there any benefits from being in this research study?

There is no direct benefit to you by participating in this research study. The public, researchers with interests in human understanding of AI decisions should benefit from the results of this study.



Will I be compensated for participating in this research?

Yes, see the survey description.



If I take part in this research, how will my privacy be protected? What happens to the information you collect?

We will collect your responses on secure servers and will not record any personally identifying information. You will be assigned a unique participant ID. Your responses, linked only to this ID, will be included in a public, open-access dataset so other researchers can reproduce and extend this work. No personal details will be shared.


Research results will be reported in aggregate, and data will be stored in line with the University’s Research Data Management Policy.



Can I refuse to participate in this research?

Yes, you can. Your decision to participate in this research is voluntary. You can also withdraw from the research at any time without giving any reasons.



If I have any questions, concerns or complaints about this research study, who can I talk to?

The researcher for this study is Louth Bin Rawshan. If you have questions, concerns, or complaints, or think the research has hurt you, please feel free to contact Louth at louth@comp.nus.edu.sg.
